matches.preview: The model makes West Ham United clear favourites, giving the visitors a 59% chance of winning, compared with 24% for the draw and 18% for a Bolton Wanderers victory. West Ham ended last season with two wins, three defeats and one draw across their final six matches, including a 3-0 home win over Leeds. Bolton’s listed results date from 2019, before their spell outside the top two English divisions, so they are history rather than current form as the club returns to this level. There are no previous meetings on record. The total-goals lean is over 2.5 at 57%, with under 2.5 at 43%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型明顯看好 West Ham United，認為客隊有 59% 的獲勝機率，相較之下，平局機率為 24%，Bolton Wanderers 獲勝的機率則為 18%。West Ham United 上季最後六場比賽取得兩勝三負一和，其中包括主場以三比零擊敗 Leeds。Bolton Wanderers 所列出的比賽結果可追溯至 2019 年，當時球隊尚未經歷離開英格蘭前兩級聯賽的那段時期，因此隨著俱樂部重返這個級別，這些結果只能視為歷史紀錄，而非近期狀態。雙方過去沒有交手紀錄。總進球數方面，超過 2.5 球的機率為 57%，低於 2.5 球的機率為 43%。

matches.preview: The model favours Norwich City, but only moderately, assigning the home side a 45% win probability. The draw is rated at 27%, with a Birmingham City win at 28%, so there is still meaningful uncertainty around the result. Norwich ended last season with three wins in six listed Championship matches, including a 4-2 victory away at Bristol City, while Birmingham finished that sequence with three wins and two draws. The recent head-to-head record favours the visitors, who won the latest three meetings, most recently 2-1 at Norwich in February. On total goals, the lean is narrowly towards over 2.5 at 51%, compared with under 2.5 at 49%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型較看好 Norwich City，但優勢有限，認為主隊的勝率為45%。和局機率為27%，Birmingham City 獲勝的機率為28%，因此比賽結果仍有相當大的不確定性。Norwich 在上季最後六場列出的 Championship 賽事中取得三勝，包括作客以4比2擊敗 Bristol City；Birmingham 則在該段賽程中取得三勝兩和。近期對戰紀錄有利於客隊，他們在最近三次交手中全數獲勝，最近一次是在2月作客 Norwich 以2比1取勝。總進球方面，超過2.5球的機率略高，為51%，低於2.5球則為49%。

matches.preview: Oracle90 rates this match as finely balanced, with Derby County and West Bromwich Albion both given a 36% chance of winning, while the draw stands at 28%. Derby’s listed results from the end of last season were mixed, with three wins and three defeats across their final six matches. West Brom finished that campaign with three clean sheets in six games, including consecutive 0-0 draws, before losing at Sheffield Wednesday. Derby have also avoided defeat in the five recent meetings supplied, winning four and drawing one. The total-goals lean is narrow, with under 2.5 goals at 51% and over 2.5 at 49%.
matches.preview_zh: Oracle90 評估本場比賽實力相當接近，Derby County 與 West Bromwich Albion 的獲勝機率均為36%，平局機率則為28%。Derby County 在上季末所列的戰績有好有壞，最後六場比賽取得三勝三敗。West Bromwich Albion 在該賽季末六場比賽中有三場零封對手，其中包括連續兩場以0比0戰平，之後則敗給Sheffield Wednesday。根據所提供的近期五次交手紀錄，Derby County 也保持不敗，取得四勝一平。總進球數的預測差距很小，低於2.5球的機率為51%，高於2.5球的機率為49%。

matches.preview: The model sees a finely balanced match, with Queens Park Rangers holding a narrow edge at 39%. Charlton Athletic are rated at 33%, while the draw stands at 28%. Both sides arrive after difficult finishes to last season. Charlton won once in their final six Championship matches, while QPR lost their final four, including a 3-0 defeat at Ipswich. The latest meeting ended 0-0 in February, although QPR won the previous encounter 3-1. A tight contest is expected, with under 2.5 goals narrowly favoured at 53%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型認為這是一場勢均力敵的比賽，Queens Park Rangers以39%的勝率稍占優勢，Charlton Athletic的勝率為33%，平局機率則為28%。兩隊上賽季收官階段的表現都不理想。Charlton在最後六場英冠比賽中僅贏一場，QPR則在最後四場比賽全數落敗，其中包括以0比3不敵Ipswich。雙方最近一次交手於二月以0比0收場，不過QPR在前一次對決中以3比1獲勝。預計比賽將相當膠著，總進球數低於2.5球的機率略高，為53%。
